# Objective

The objective of this R analysis is to explore the reproducibility of smartphone-based accelerometry for quantifying cerebellar tremor frequency across repeated grasping tasks and across three consecutive days.

The analysis is based on the dominant tremor frequency and RMS amplitude extracted from Python using FFT.



# 1. Import dataframe from the final data folder

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
all_results <- read.csv("final_data/all_results.csv")
View(all_results)
```
